description: This file defines a Java class NativeStackFrameSnapshot representing a native (C/C++) stack frame within a thread, extending from a superclass StackFrameSnapshot. It includes fields for the library name, symbol, and offset, and provides a clone method.

classes.name: NativeStackFrameSnapshot
classes.description: Represents a native C/C++ stack frame inside a thread with fields for library, symbol, and offset.

methods.name: clone
methods.description: Creates and returns a copy of the current NativeStackFrameSnapshot instance.
